Karnataka Farmers Face Crop Losses Due to Deficient Rainfall

Farmers in Karnataka's Mandya district are experiencing the effects of deficient rainfall on their ragi crops. In Davangere, approximately 75% of the maize crop has been lost due to the rainfall deficit, though ragi is considered more resilient to such conditions.
